subject: proj
title: (R)PROJ.------AF.DY.
description: Second diagram on page 391 (JR-13), paired with PROJ × C-INFO above. The crossing diagrams the same projection-axis at its *reality*-prefix level, crossed with affinity-dynamics: (R)PROJ (the reality of projection — projection in its actual working form) crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics — the partner-axis's actual affinity-working). PROJ sits centrally-up with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-right to AF-DY. COS-P (cosmic-particulars) at top-right branches from the main line, with C-CONT (composite continuance) branching from COS-P's line and INFO-CON (information convergence) dropping from C-CONT's line. MT-INFO (multi-information) at upper-left branches from the main line; AF-POST (affinity postulation) drops from MT-INFO's line, and INTL (intellectualism) and LG-EXT (logical extension) branch from AF-POST's line. TR (transformation) branches from the main line at lower-right; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) branches from TR's line and RE-ST (restructuralism) from TH-CONT's line. AF-DY sits at the bottom-center as partner-axis. Structural argument: when the reality of projection is crossed with affinity-dynamics, the upper diagonal COS-P → C-CONT is the *cosmic-continuance route* — cosmic-particulars route through composite-continuance.
